correctness.rationale: The pinned RESULT.md constructs the complete Alexander dual: 2-skeleton plus tetrahedra from induced P4/claws and pentagonal 4-simplices, no larger faces. Girth ≥5 makes each P4 belong to at most one pentagon; private triangular faces permit elementary collapse of all remaining tetrahedra. The simply connected dual reduces to a two-complex with second Betti rank binomial(n-1,3)-c4+p5; c4 equals claw count plus central-edge P4 count. Integral Alexander duality and full low-dimensional skeleton of Δ4 for n≥9 yield an (n-5)-sphere wedge via Hurewicz/Whitehead, including disconnected graphs. Independent C5-plus-isolates enumerations gave B=52 for n9 and B=60 for n10, not proof of all n.
residual_risks: Bounded computations are not proofs of all-parameter or asymptotic theorems.
